questionText:
Arrange the progressive generation of color families on the standard 12-hue Prang color wheel:
(A) Primary Hues: Red, Yellow, and Blue (cannot be formed by mixing any other colors)
(B) Secondary Hues: Orange, Green, and Violet (formed by mixing equal parts of two adjacent primaries)
(C) Tertiary / Intermediate Hues: Red-Orange, Yellow-Orange, Yellow-Green, Blue-Green, Blue-Violet, Red-Violet
(D) Neutral / Achromatic Hues: White, Black, and Grey (devoid of spectral hue)

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: D, B, C, A

options.text: A, C, B, D

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Color wheel mixing progresses: primary base (A) -> secondary blends (B) -> tertiary intermediate mixtures (C) -> neutral achromatic tones (D).
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.

solution.concept: Fabric and Apparel: Prang Color Wheel Mixing Progression.

Detailed Solution:
